2610.05225.title: GFGE: Unifying Explainable AI Methods through an Interpretation Framework
2610.05225.paper_summary: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) encompasses methods that draw on different sources of information and address different explanatory needs. A common framework is needed to describe how this information becomes evidence and is communicated as an explanation for a particular recipient. We propose the General Framework for Generating Explanations (GFGE), grounded in interpretative frameworks and the complementary activities of \emph{sense-reading} and \emph{sense-giving}. Its conceptual foundation is the Interpret/Explain Schema (IES), which connects an analyst's interpretation of system evidence, the communication of a selected account, and the recipient's interpretation of that account. GFGE operationalises this schema through five roles: data interpretation, model interpretation, output interpretation, optional post-hoc analysis, and aggregation. A role-typed operation graph records method-specific dependencies, while evidence records retain the sources, assumptions, and limitations of explanatory claims. The explanatory question, audience, and context guide the procedure. We instantiate GFGE for attribution, surrogate, counterfactual, concept and prototype, intrinsic rule, argumentation, and language-model methods. These instantiations show how intrinsic, post-hoc, and hybrid workflows can be represented through the same roles while preserving their distinct evidential requirements. GFGE provides a common basis for analysing explanation workflows, tracing communicated claims to their evidence, and identifying unresolved explanatory dependencies.
2610.05225.paper_summary_zh: 可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）涵蓋了基於不同信息來源並滿足不同解釋需求的方法。需要一個共同的框架來描述這些信息如何成為證據並被傳達為特定接收者的解釋。我們提出了生成解釋的一般框架（GFGE），該框架基於詮釋框架以及\emph{sense-reading}和\emph{sense-giving}的互補活動。其概念基礎是詮釋/解釋架構（IES），該架構連接分析師對系統證據的詮釋、選定說明的傳達以及接收者對該說明的詮釋。GFGE通過五個角色來具體化這一架構：數據詮釋、模型詮釋、輸出詮釋、可選的事後分析和聚合。角色類型的操作圖記錄方法特定的依賴關係，而證據記錄保留了解釋性主張的來源、假設和限制。解釋問題、受眾和背景指導著這一過程。我們為歸因、代理、反事實、概念和原型、內在規則、論證和語言模型方法實例化GFGE。這些實例顯示了內在、事後和混合工作流程如何通過相同的角色來表示，同時保留其獨特的證據要求。GFGE為分析解釋工作流程提供了共同的基礎，追溯傳達的主張到其證據，並識別未解決的解釋依賴關係。
2610.05225.author: Jinfeng Zhong et.al.
